messages:
maria: Quick sync on HelixHealth private deploy — need a network acceptance sweep and air-gap blockers recap. Who can confirm firewall + DNS + smoke tests today?

sam: I can take firewall rules. I need the exact CIDR/IP list from infra and whether they want 443 only or additional ports.

lee: @sam I have the CIDRs from Helix (sent to ticket). They require outbound to these ranges for model pulls and telemetry: 35.212.0.0/16, 104.198.0.0/16, 18.205.0.0/16. We should allow 443 and 10250 (kube metrics) per their ops.

angela: DNS note: Helix will use private zones. I need the full list of hostnames to pre-seed. Can someone paste?

priyanka: Air-gap checklist owner here. Main blockers: (1) image import path for model artifacts, (2) no direct outbound from app nodes -> need allowed egress or proxy, (3) HSM/KMS handshake testing.

maria: Good. Summarize owners: sam -> firewall rules, angela -> DNS entries, lee -> smoke tests/staging run, priyanka -> air-gap checklist + HSM test. I'll coordinate with customer for a Tuesday window. :date:

sam: For clarity, firewall change request I will file to security. Draft rules below — please review before I raise ticket:
```
# HelixHealth egress allow list
- 35.212.0.0/16:443
- 104.198.0.0/16:443
- 18.205.0.0/16:443
- 10.10.10.0/24:10250 (Helix k8s metrics)
```

lee: LGTM. I'll run the quick curl checks from staging once rules are in place. Example smoke command: `curl -sS https://model-storage.helixhealth.internal/healthz -I` — expecting 200.

angela: Hostname list from Helix (paste from their email): model-storage.helixhealth.internal, api.helixhealth.internal, logshipper.helixhealth.internal. I'll pre-create records in private zone and hand to infra.

priyanka: HSM note: Helix uses a customer HSM behind a proxy. We need to validate TLS SNI passthrough and ensure our cert chain works. I will run a cert handshake test tomorrow AM and share results.

maria: Blocker tracker: please paste any blockers here. If none, we aim for staging smoke Wed and production cutover next Monday.

sam: Filed the firewall RFC: https://rwd.ms/r/12345 — put all related logs & diffs there. Tagging @security.

ops-bot: Reminder — runbook template for private deploys updated. See /docs/runbooks/private-deploy.md

lee: Quick check — do we need to open 22 for maintenance? Helix said they do not allow SSH; we should keep 22 closed and use bastion if required.

angela: Confirmed: no 22. We'll use bastion with strict ACLs.

maria: Final action items: sam (firewall RFC + follow security), angela (DNS records + share zone export), lee (staging smoke + curl logs), priyanka (HSM handshake + air-gap checklist). I'll book a 30m sync Thu to verify staging results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
